items.title: What an Unlikely Seat at the Table Taught a Former CEO About Leadership
items.summary: Mark Weinberger, former Global Chairman and CEO of EY, says joining Saudi Aramco’s board was not an easy decision. Speaking with Poppy Harlow at the WSJ Leadership Institute Board of Directors Summit in Palm Beach, Florida, Weinberger reflects on the concerns he faced, the advice he received and why he believes bringing different perspectives into the boardroom leads to better decisions.

items.title: Is Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Below Fair Value On Cash Flow?
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson has delivered a powerful share price run in recent years, which puts a sharper spotlight on whether the current valuation lines up with the cash the business is expected to generate. With the stock now trading at US$282.11, the question for investors is how that price stacks up against an intrinsic value estimate built on its future cash flows. The share price has returned 108.1% over the past 3 years, which means a lot of good news is already reflected in the market value...
